mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS tenantId, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, t.status AS status, t.expire_time AS expireTime, up.is_primary AS isPrimary, up.id AS tenantUserId FROM sys_user_policy up INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = up.target_id AND up.target_type = 'TENANT' AND t.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' ORDER BY up.is_primary DESC, t.tenant_code

SELECT r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, up_role.status AS rolePolicyStatus, 'SELF' AS dataScope, -- TODO: 后续从角色配置或权限策略中查询真实的数据范围 up_tenant.id AS tenantUserId FROM sys_user_policy up_tenant -- 用户加入租户（target_type='TENANT'） INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = up_tenant.target_id AND up_tenant.target_type = 'TENANT' AND t.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' -- 租户用户绑定角色（user_id=租户用户ID, target_type='ROLE'） LEFT JOIN sys_user_policy up_role ON up_role.user_id = up_tenant.id AND up_role.target_type = 'ROLE' AND up_role.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' -- 租户策略表（租户角色ID → 系统角色ID） LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_policy tp ON tp.id = up_role.target_id AND tp.source_type = 'ROLE' AND tp.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' -- 系统角色表 LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = tp.source_id AND r.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' WHERE up_tenant.user_id = #{userId} AND up_tenant.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' ORDER BY t.tenant_code, r.role_code

SELECT d.dept_code AS deptCode, d.dept_name AS deptName, d.path AS path, d.level AS level, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, up_dept.is_primary AS isPrimary, up_dept.status AS userPolicyStatus, up_tenant.id AS tenantUserId FROM sys_user_policy up_tenant -- 用户加入租户（target_type='TENANT'） INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = up_tenant.target_id AND up_tenant.target_type = 'TENANT' AND t.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' -- 租户用户绑定部门（user_id=租户用户ID, target_type='DEPT'） LEFT JOIN sys_user_policy up_dept ON up_dept.user_id = up_tenant.id AND up_dept.target_type = 'DEPT' AND up_dept.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' -- 租户策略表（租户部门ID → 系统部门ID） LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_policy tp ON tp.id = up_dept.target_id AND tp.source_type = 'DEPT' AND tp.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' -- 系统部门表 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = tp.source_id AND d.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' WHERE up_tenant.user_id = #{userId} AND up_tenant.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' ORDER BY t.tenant_code, d.dept_code
